# YIVPN (易VPN) — Official GitHub Release & Verification Hub

> YIVPN is a zero-activity-logs VPN client built on sing-box 1.14.3 (Hysteria2 QUIC & VLESS+REALITY) for Windows 10/11, macOS 11+ (Universal), and Android 7.0+ (iOS Coming Soon). Every device receives 90 minutes of free encrypted protection daily with no sign-up, email, or credit card required. Paid YiPro plans start at $2.99/month ($21.99/year, ~$1.83/mo) for up to 5 simultaneous devices.
